title: ENCHTABLE: Unified Safety Alignment Transfer in Fine-tuned Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'safety alignment,' which is explicitly defined as ensuring models adhere to 'ethical guidelines' to prevent harmful outputs. It evaluates this using safety benchmarks like BeaverTail and SaladBench, which include categories for harmful, toxic, and stereotypical content, thereby evaluating the model's adherence to an ethical safety framework.
